verdict.rationale: Sentry exposes a general web API for managing organizations, teams, and data (sentry-docs-14, sentry-docs-20) which could in principle be used to script dashboard/alert creation, and alerts/dashboards are core product features (sentry-docs-3, sentry-docs-4, sentry-docs-21, sentry-docs-22). However, there is no evidence of a dedicated Terraform provider, JSON schema for dashboards-as-code, or documented repeatable provisioning workflow specific to dashboards/alerts. Missing for 10: Terraform provider/module for Sentry alerts or dashboards, documented JSON/YAML config format for dashboards-as-code, and any hands-on or docs confirmation of idempotent repeatable provisioning via API.
